ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.15; the visible surface is predominantly composed of low-intensity black pixels (~85%) with high-intensity white pixels (~15%) localized at distal tips and inferior margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary low-intensity (black) pigmentation covers the superior and central regions of both lobes. High-intensity (white) contiguous blobs are mapped to the distal lateral tips of both lobes. An irregular mottled high-intensity region is visible on the inferior-distal quadrant of the right lobe. High-intensity pixel fringing is observed along the inferior boundary where the fluke meets the waterline.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detected at both distal lateral tips; characterized by high-contrast white circular pixel clusters typically associated with barnacle colonization sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive white scarring and calcified-look markers at the extreme left and right tips of the fluke lobes.
